fusions.name: Silk Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of silk that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, with a 60% chance to leave targets [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Venom Drop
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A drop of venom deals 8 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Trip Line
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 3 enemies within 7.5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchored Thread
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
